claims.statement: For every finite simple graph G with maximum degree at most 4, omega(L(G)^2) is at most 20, and equality occurs.
claims.classification: rigorous modulo Kumar-Mohar-Pragada Corollary 1.7, with independently checked exact rounding and construction

claims.statement: The maximum strong chromatic index over graphs of maximum degree at most 4 lies between 20 and 21 inclusive.
claims.classification: rigorous modulo Huang-Santana-Yu Theorem 2 for the upper bound; elementary explicit construction for the lower bound

claims.statement: The Erdos-Nesetril strong chromatic index conjecture remains open at Delta=4 and in general.

disclosures: The arXiv v1 proof has an auxiliary beta-star interval typo; the audit reconstructs the lemma with beta fixed at 620/1987.
Local ledger Problem 934 cites the same paper for its different h_3 / L(G)^3 section. The Delta=4 L(G)^2 result and coefficient were not treated locally.
